brief.note: The Fed raised rates and signalled more; Enova's abandoned bank deal and J.B. Hunt's cost warning led falls.

candidates.name: Enova International, Inc.
candidates.business: Online lender providing consumer and small-business credit in the United States
candidates.cause: Withdrew its regulatory applications to buy Grasshopper Bancorp, abandoning a $369m deal, after the chief executive cited unclear rules for nonbanks seeking bank status.
candidates.right: The lending business must keep compounding without the cheaper deposit funding a bank would bring
candidates.wrong: Funding costs stay high and the failed deal signals deeper regulatory hostility to nonbank lenders

candidates.name: The Cooper Companies, Inc.
candidates.business: Makes contact lenses and women's health and fertility medical devices
candidates.cause: Revenue missed and full-year guidance was cut, while a long-running strategic review ended with no sale. Several brokers downgraded the shares.
candidates.right: Organic growth must improve now that no buyer is going to pay a premium
candidates.wrong: Contact lens growth stays near 1% and the guidance cuts keep coming

candidates.name: J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc.
candidates.business: Trucking and intermodal freight carrier hauling containers across North America
candidates.cause: Warned mid-quarter that third-quarter profit will fall 5% to 10% from the second, on $25m more driver pay and higher fuel costs.
candidates.right: Freight rates must rise enough to pass on driver pay and fuel increases
candidates.wrong: A soft freight market leaves the cost inflation stuck on Hunt's own margins
